summary: mandate-planner validates a proposed agency charter against an explicit authority grant and emits runx.agency.mandate_plan.v1 only when the charter is within granted roles, spend, turns, and has a measurable done_check.

recommended_charter.done_check: when the migration guide is published and the review receipt status equals verified

observations.name: signal_weights
observations.role_grant_check: every candidate_roster role must appear in authority_grant.granted_roles
observations.limit_check: requested spend and max_turns must be less than or equal to authority_grant ceilings
observations.done_check: done_check must contain a measurable predicate; missing or vague done checks route to human approval

observations.name: dispatch_boundary
observations.value: The skill does not call agency.open. It emits a verdict and stops; a downstream driver or operator may issue a separate governed agency.open run by naming this verdict.

observations.name: local_harness_status
observations.value: Inline harness cases are declared in X.yaml. On this Windows host, runx harness reached both cases but receipt store initialization returned os error 87; the failure is captured in local-harness.json and was not hidden.

input.objective: Publish a migration guide for the agency quickstart.
